title: Cognitive overload and rest dataset. Simultaneous EEG + PPG + ECG + eye-tracking
description: This dataset contains raw 64-channel EEG recorded simultaneously with electrocardiography (ECG), photoplethysmography (PPG), eye-tracking/pupillometry, and behavioral data from 124 healthy young adults. Recordings cover a resting-state session (alternating eyes-closed and eyes-open blocks followed by passive cartoon viewing) and an adaptive verbal working memory digit-span task with serial recall. It supports research on cognitive load, working memory, and the psychophysiological correlates of rest and overload.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 64-channel Brain Products system, with ECG and PPG recorded from the amplifier's AUX channels. Eye-tracking and pupillometry were recorded with a Pupil Labs Core wearable eye-tracker. In the adaptive digit-span task, participants saw digit sequences and recalled them in serial order by typing on a numpad. Trials were grouped into blocks of 10, and sequence length increased when 7 or more trials in a block were correct and decreased otherwise. The resting-state session consisted of four 1-minute blocks of alternating eyes-closed and eyes-open rest, followed by about 4 minutes of passive cartoon watching.
